game.title: Prey
game.blurb: First-person immersive sim and shooter aboard the Talos I space station, from Arkane Studios, released 2017-05-05. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Talos I: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The story milestones and side tasks across the station. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Typhon Powers and Human Abilities
chapters.summary: Acquiring powers and abilities, mimicking objects, Phantom powers, Mindjack, Lift, Psychoshock and Electrostatic Burst.

chapters.title: Playstyle Runs
chapters.summary: Finishing without neuromods, without killing humans, with only one kind of power, or killing every human.

chapters.title: Exploring Talos I
chapters.summary: Finding every employee, reading every e-mail, every TranScribe recording and every kind of food and drink.

chapters.title: Combat, Repairs and Hacking
chapters.summary: Mimic fights, Combat Focus, weapon upgrades, recycling, repairs and hacking.

chapters.title: Mooncrash
chapters.summary: The Mooncrash expansion: characters, story objectives, KASMA orders, escapes and its enemies.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's "prey" entry (id 39) is the 2017 Arkane game; the 2006 game is a separate entry ("prey-2006"). Steam app 480490 is used; "Prey: Typhon Hunter" (app 741820) was not. StrategyWiki has "Prey (2017)" as a stub (completion stage 0); only its Table of Contents subpage is written, so nothing was used. prey.fandom.com has "Prey (2017)" with about 19 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 23 of 58 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the main story chapter, including some low-percentage ones such as "Awkward Ride Home" (1.4%), "Makeup Exam" (2.5%) and "Black Market" (6.8%), which may be optional tasks. The 10 Mooncrash achievements all name Mooncrash in their descriptions.
